methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The total Budget Index, already seen in literature, is divided in two components, one related to the difference in total energy consumption inside the plant (EC, Energy Consumption Index) and the other related to the difference in the global specific energy cost (SC, specific energy cost Index).

paper_type.evidence_quote: the presented methodology has been applied to the case study of an Italian manufacturing company in order to prove its usefulness and its validity in the specific case.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The company produces consumer goods and is classified as energy-intensive.
